answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the reef of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Work waits on the saffron until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the quartz of the next round. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, reduced by each unverified claim, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
